component.summary: Unofficial notes client compatible with Samsung Notes
Samsung Notes ile uyumlu, resmi olmayan not istemcisi

description.p: Notes is a desktop notes application that reads and writes notes in the Samsung Notes format and keeps them in sync with your Samsung Cloud account: handwritten pages, text notes, folders, favorites and the trash.

ul.li: Handwritten pages rendered from the original strokes, with pen, eraser and lasso tools
Rich text editing, PDF backgrounds and page management
Works offline; changes are queued and verified after upload

description.p: Unofficial client compatible with Samsung Notes and Samsung Cloud. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. "Samsung", "Samsung Notes" and "Galaxy" are trademarks of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., used only to describe compatibility.
